_meta.description: Line 6's stations in order from Swami Samarth Nagar to Vikhroli (EEH), as MMRDA's Line 6 page lists them. MMRDA names no phases, so stations carry none. 'kml_name' is the station's point in MMRDA's alignment file. Positions and along_m come from scripts/build-alignment-line6.py. Names follow MMRDA's list; 'Maha kali Caves' is written Mahakali Caves, as in its introduction and alignment file. name_mr follows MMRDA's Marathi page; Mahakali Caves is null because that page gives 'महाकाली काव', which looks cut short.

location.method: MMRDA alignment file for Line 6 (KML on the Metro Influence Zone page, uploaded March 2025): point "SWAMI SAMARTH NAGAR (M) STATION". along_m is measured along a centre line derived from MMRDA's corridor polygon, from Swami Samarth Nagar station; the point is 13 m from that line.

context.text: The western end of the line, near Lokhandwala in Andheri (W).

construction_status.notes: MMRDA publishes progress for the whole line only (station works 87.35% as of 31 Aug 2026), not by station. Civil package BC-03 (J Kumar Infraprojects, with CRTG), Swami Samarth Nagar to Shyam Nagar; station finishing CA-266 (Landmark-Neev JV) (The Metro Rail Guy).
